name.ja: 酵素反応の保存と準定常近似

caption.ja: 全4状態と準定常近似を比較し、初期層と積分誤差を分けます。 保存値だけを描画します。 時間・濃度・個体数の軸は空間次元ではありません。率は教育用で疾病・実験予測ではありません。
caption.en: Separate the initial layer, integration error and QSSA modeling error in a four-state enzyme mechanism. This figure reads saved data only. Time, concentrations and populations do not define a spatial dimension. The rates are educational, not disease or experimental predictions.

note.ja: 酵素・基質・複合体の反応と飽和速度則。完全反応系、迅速平衡近似、準定常近似の違いは解説先へ。 限定した実行例：2つの小εと固定反応定数だけの教育例です。εは尺度比であり、その値だけを厳密なQSSA誤差上界とはしません。θ≥0.02を初期層終了の証明とは呼ばず、生体内の反応・観測値へ外挿しません。
note.en: Enzyme saturation; the full mass-action system resolves the transient complex C, while the rate law eliminates a fast variable. The 1913 rapid-equilibrium interpretation and the 1925 quasi-steady-state derivation must remain distinct. Scoped executed example: These two small-ε fixed-rate examples are educational. ε is a scale ratio, not itself a certified QSSA error bound. The θ≥0.02 window is not a proof that the initial layer has ended, and the calculation is not an in-vivo prediction.

equation_note.ja: 閉鎖反応E+S⇌C→E+Pを無次元化し、k₁=10、k₋₁=k₂=1、S₀=1、C₀=P₀=0、E₀=0.01/0.002。Kₘ=0.2、ε=E₀/(Kₘ+S₀)=1/120,1/600、θ=E₀t∈[0,0.5]です。
equation_note.en: Use the closed dimensionless reaction E+S⇌C→E+P with k₁=10, k₋₁=k₂=1, S₀=1, C₀=P₀=0 and E₀=0.01 or 0.002. Then Kₘ=0.2, ε=E₀/(Kₘ+S₀)=1/120 or 1/600, and θ=E₀t ranges from 0 to 0.5.

title.ja: 酵素反応の保存と準定常近似

references.formula: \begin{aligned}\dot S&=-10ES+C,&\dot C&=10ES-2C,\\\dot E&=-10ES+2C,&\dot P&=C.\end{aligned};\quad E+C=E_0,\quad S+C+P=1,\quad K_m=\frac{k_{-1}+k_2}{k_1}=0.2;\quad \theta=E_0t,\quad \varepsilon=\frac{E_0}{K_m+S_0}\in\left\{\frac1{120},\frac1{600}\right\};\quad \frac{dS_{\rm MM}}{d\theta}=-\frac{S_{\rm MM}}{0.2+S_{\rm MM}},\quad S_{\rm MM}+0.2\log S_{\rm MM}=1-\theta

assumptions.ja: 閉鎖反応E+S⇌C→E+Pを無次元化し、k₁=10、k₋₁=k₂=1、S₀=1、C₀=P₀=0、E₀=0.01/0.002。Kₘ=0.2、ε=E₀/(Kₘ+S₀)=1/120,1/600、θ=E₀t∈[0,0.5]です。
assumptions.en: Use the closed dimensionless reaction E+S⇌C→E+P with k₁=10, k₋₁=k₂=1, S₀=1, C₀=P₀=0 and E₀=0.01 or 0.002. Then Kₘ=0.2, ε=E₀/(Kₘ+S₀)=1/120 or 1/600, and θ=E₀t ranges from 0 to 0.5.

note.ja: 2つの小εと固定反応定数だけの教育例です。εは尺度比であり、その値だけを厳密なQSSA誤差上界とはしません。θ≥0.02を初期層終了の証明とは呼ばず、生体内の反応・観測値へ外挿しません。
note.en: These two small-ε fixed-rate examples are educational. ε is a scale ratio, not itself a certified QSSA error bound. The θ≥0.02 window is not a proof that the initial layer has ended, and the calculation is not an in-vivo prediction.

reference_note.ja: 独立な全系Radau/BDF参照、縮約式の陰的スカラー恒等式、E+C=E₀とS+C+P=1、正値性、実際の採用・棄却・Newton作業を照合。初期層を含む全時間と、事前指定θ≥0.02の近似誤差を別保存します。
reference_note.en: Compare with independent full-system Radau/BDF references and an implicit scalar identity for the reduced equation. Check E+C=E₀, S+C+P=1, positivity and actual acceptance, rejection and Newton work. Retain both all-time errors including the initial layer and errors on the declared θ≥0.02 window.

method_note.ja: 全4状態をSDIRK2のstep doublingで積分し、各段のNewton法では同じ重み付きL∞残差とArmijo条件を使います。縮約Michaelis–Menten式はθ上の別RK4計算で求め、全系の積分誤差と近似モデル誤差を混同しません。
method_note.en: Integrate all four states with SDIRK2 step doubling, using the same weighted L∞ residual for Newton convergence and Armijo backtracking. Evolve the reduced Michaelis–Menten equation separately with RK4 in θ, keeping integration error distinct from model-reduction error.
